description: Checks IPv4 addresses against 12 free public blocklists (IPsum, FireHOL levels 1-3, Spamhaus DROP, blocklist.de, CINS Army, GreenSnow, DShield, ET compromised, Tor exits), the same lists as logtriage.app's IP blocklist checker. Accepts a list of addresses or any text containing them (log lines, CSV); private and other special-purpose ranges are labelled, not looked up. Up to 500 addresses per call. Lists are refreshed twice a day. Being on a list is evidence, not proof. Free; no API key needed.

text.description: IPv4 addresses, or text that contains them.

name: check_ip_blocklists
title: Check IP addresses against free blocklists
